# XDMOD Manual

> XDMOD: a method and tools for cross-domain, multi-repo systems engineering.


2026, XDMOD Manual

## Pages in this subsection

- [Decisions](index.html.md): This part records every decision about the XDMOD framework. Each decision is a need of type
- [Method and model](method.html.md): How the system is modelled: SysML v2, SYSMOD, requirements, views and variants.
- [Traces and IDs](traces.html.md): The trace rule, link types, need kinds and the ID scheme.
- [Documents](documents.html.md): The linked document set, zdocs, and how documents get their content.
- [Repos and workspace](repos.html.md): Repos, the west workspace, names, tags and paths.
- [Checks, CI and evidence](checks.html.md): Where checks run, CI, tool limits, generated files and test evidence.
- [Workflow and agents](workflow.html.md): Branches, merging, reviews, and what agents may do.
- [Scope and iterations](scope.html.md): What is in iteration 1 and what moved to iteration 2.

- [Top-level llms.txt](../../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
